name: Coffee Shop - Hartenbos
address: Cnr 7 Kompanje &, Spar, Kaap De Goede Hoop Ave, Hartenbos, Mossel Bay, 6520, South Africa
description_short: Neighbourhood coffee shop in Hartenbos serving quality coffee, light meals and takeaways near the Spar.
description_long:
Tucked in the heart of Hartenbos at the corner of 7 Kompanje and Kaap De Goede Hoop Avenue, this friendly coffee shop has become a local favourite for morning brews and casual meals. The convenient location next to Spar makes it an easy stop whether you're popping in for a quick caffeine fix or settling in for breakfast.

The menu covers all the coffee shop essentials — from cappuccinos and lattes to light meals, sandwiches and fresh bakes. It's the kind of unpretentious spot where you'll find locals catching up over coffee and families grabbing takeaways. The relaxed vibe suits Hartenbos perfectly, serving the beach community with consistent quality and a warm welcome.
